initial_support: same frozen four paid records, empirical incumbent and safe support retained in all branches; no terminal data enters posterior
posterior: actual JointResponseMixture.update_raw and Gaussian paid filter, no new prior parameters; one raw f/g episode debits one simulation call
search_action: restricted one-step intervention, new point 63 and repeat 2 frozen from earlier predictive probes; not a search over every candidate's KG
terminal_selection: same complete guarded/direct action class and shared-budget marginal integration; terminal action frozen before independent safety/objective streams
randomness: new/repeat arms share observation seed and noise coordinates within each group; terminal verifier uses existing seed/count/position stream rules, so stop and sampled branches have different verification streams
primary_endpoints: certified true-feasible reward, certification count, actual total calls; report true conditional expected terminal reward/calls after all twelve actions and verifications have frozen
numerical_followup: if a gap to another primary is below .003 and numerical ranking could change the adoption conclusion, audit only that saved posterior at 8192 nodes with seed 80592; do not replace the first decision or generate more episodes
source_cost: 384 source simulator calls per reused archive already paid; source fitted once; zero new source calls
execution: local serial single-thread; four groups, twelve terminal branches, exactly eight new search episodes; each branch at most 362 total calls including reused initial four; no server jobs or pulls
scope: one opened fixed Inventory law, same initial noise realization; four new episode/verifier randomizations are not independent tasks or confirmation of generalization
